text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟和亚郎说：

text_en: Take a census of the Kohathites separate from the other Levites, by their clans and their ancestral houses,
text_cn: “你应依照宗族和家系，统计肋未人中的刻哈特子孙，

text_en: from thirty years old up to fifty years old, all who qualify to do work relating to the tent of meeting.
text_cn: 由三十岁以上到五十岁，凡应入伍到会幕服务的都要登记。

text_en: The service of the Kohathites relating to the tent of meeting concerns the most holy things.
text_cn: 刻哈特子孙在会幕内的任务，是管理至圣之物。

text_en: When the camp is to set out, Aaron and his sons shall go in and take down the screening curtain, and cover the ark of the covenant with it;
text_cn: 起营出发时，亚郎和他的儿子应来卸下帐幔，用来包裹约柜，

text_en: then they shall put on it a covering of fine leather, and spread over that a cloth all of blue, and shall put its poles in place.
text_cn: 上面蒙上海豚皮盖，其上再铺上纯紫布，然后安上杠杆。

text_en: Over the table of the bread of the Presence they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the plates, the dishes for incense, the bowls, and the flagons for the drink offering; the regular bread also shall be on it;
text_cn: 在供饼桌上，应铺上紫布，摆上盘、匙、杯和奠酒的爵；常供饼应仍在桌上。

text_en: then they shall spread over them a crimson cloth, and cover it with a covering of fine leather, and shall put its poles in place.
text_cn: 以后，在这些物件上，盖上朱红布，再蒙上海豚皮罩，然后安上杠杆。

text_en: They shall take a blue cloth, and cover the lampstand for the light, with its lamps, its snuffers, its trays, and all the vessels for oil with which it is supplied;
text_cn: 此后，拿一块紫布，包好灯台和灯盏、剪子、碟子，以及为灯台用的一切油具；

text_en: and they shall put it with all its utensils in a covering of fine leather, and put it on the carrying frame.
text_cn: 将灯台和所有的用具，装入海豚皮袋内，放在担架上。

text_en: Over the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of fine leather, and shall put its poles in place;
text_cn: 在金祭坛上铺上紫布，再用海豚皮包好，然后安上杠杆。

text_en: and they shall take all the utensils of the service that are used in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, and cover them with a covering of fine leather, and put them on the carrying frame.
text_cn: 再把圣所内使用的一切用具都拿来，放在紫布袋内，再蒙上海豚皮罩，放在担架上。

text_en: They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth over it;
text_cn: 把祭坛上的灰清除，铺上紫红布，

text_en: and they shall put on it all the utensils of the altar, which are used for the service there, the firepans, the forks, the shovels, and the basins, all the utensils of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of fine leather, and shall put its poles in place.
text_cn: 上面放上一切用具：火盆、肉叉、铲子、盘子以及祭坛上的一切用具；其上再蒙上海豚皮罩，然后安上杠杆。

text_en: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furnishings of the sanctuary, as the camp sets out, after that the Kohathites shall come to carry these, but they must not touch the holy things, or they will die. These are the things of the tent of meeting that the Kohathites are to carry.
text_cn: 亚郎和他的儿子包装完了圣物和圣所的一切用具，起营出发时，刻哈特的子孙才来抬，免得他们触摸圣物而死亡：这是刻哈特的子孙对会幕的职务。

text_en: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest shall have charge of the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the regular grain offering, and the anointing oil, the oversight of all the tabernacle and all that is in it, in the sanctuary and in its utensils.
text_cn: 至于亚郎大司祭的儿子厄肋阿匝尔的任务，是管理灯油、香料、日献的素祭和为傅礼用的油，并照管全会幕与其中所有的圣物和器具。”

text_en: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟和亚郎说：

text_en: You must not let the tribe of the clans of the Kohathites be destroyed from among the Levites.
text_cn: “不要使刻哈特族的一支由肋未人中消灭；

text_en: This is how you must deal with them in order that they may live and not die when they come near to the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and assign each to a particular task or burden.
text_cn: 为使他们接近至圣之物时，生存而不死亡，你们对他们应这样做：亚郎和他的儿子先来，给他们每人指定各人服役和搬运的工作，

text_en: But the Kohathites must not go in to look on the holy things even for a moment; otherwise they will die.
text_cn: 免得这些人进去一时见到圣物而遭遇死亡。”

text_en: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Take a census of the Gershonites also, by their ancestral houses and by their clans;
text_cn: “你要依照家系和宗族统计革尔雄的子孙，

text_en: from thirty years old up to fifty years old you shall enroll them, all who qualify to do work in the tent of meeting.
text_cn: 由三十岁以上到五十岁，凡应入伍到会幕服务的，都要登记。

text_en: This is the service of the clans of the Gershonites, in serving and bearing burdens:
text_cn: 革尔雄家族的任务是服役和搬运：

text_en: They shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tent of meeting with its covering, and the outer covering of fine leather that is on top of it, and the screen for the entrance of the tent of meeting,
text_cn: 搬运帐幕的帷幔、会幕和其顶蓬，及在上面盖的海豚皮和会幕的门帘，

text_en: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the entrance of the gate of the court that is around the tabernacle and the altar, and their cords, and all the equipment for their service; and they shall do all that needs to be done with regard to them.
text_cn: 庭院的帷幔，围绕会幕和祭坛庭院的门帘、绳索以及一切为服役用的器具；凡交与他们应作的一切，他们都应执行。

text_en: All the service of the Gershonites shall be at the command of Aaron and his sons, in all that they are to carry, and in all that they have to do; and you shall assign to their charge all that they are to carry.
text_cn: 革尔雄人所有的任务，不论是搬运或是服役，应全遵照亚郎和他儿子的吩咐；所以你们应照顾他们搬运一切：

text_en: This is the service of the clans of the Gershonites relating to the tent of meeting, and their responsibilities are to be under the oversight of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
text_cn: 这是革尔雄人的家族对会幕的任务；他们应在大司祭亚郎的儿子依塔玛尔指挥下服役。

text_en: As for the Merarites, you shall enroll them by their clans and their ancestral houses;
text_cn: 对默辣黎的子孙，你要依照宗族和家系统计他们；

text_en: from thirty years old up to fifty years old you shall enroll them, everyone who qualifies to do the work of the tent of meeting.
text_cn: 由三十岁以上到五十岁，凡应入伍到会幕服务的，都要登记。

text_en: This is what they are charged to carry, as the whole of their service in the tent of meeting: the frames of the tabernacle, with its bars, pillars, and bases,
text_cn: 依照他们在会幕内所担任的职务，应搬运的是：帐幕的木板、横木、柱子和卯（mǎo）座，

text_en: and the pillars of the court all around with their bases, pegs, and cords, with all their equipment and all their related service; and you shall assign by name the objects that they are required to carry.
text_cn: 庭院四周的柱子、卯（mǎo）座、橛子和绳索，一切用具及服务所需的一切。你们应按名一一指定他们应搬运的物件：

text_en: This is the service of the clans of the Merarites, the whole of their service relating to the tent of meeting, under the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
text_cn: 这是默辣黎人的家族，在司祭亚郎的儿子依塔玛尔指挥下，对会幕应尽的各种职务。”

text_en: So Moses and Aaron and the leaders of the congregation enrolled the Kohathites, by their clans and their ancestral houses,
text_cn: 梅瑟和亚郎及会众的首领，依照宗族和家系统计了刻哈特的子孙，

text_en: from thirty years old up to fifty years old, everyone who qualified for work relating to the tent of meeting;
text_cn: 由三十岁以上到五十岁，凡应入伍到会幕服务，

text_en: and their enrollment by clans was two thousand seven hundred fifty.
text_cn: 依照宗族登记的，共二千七百五十人：

text_en: This was the enrollment of the clans of the Kohathites, all who served at the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron enrolled according to the commandment of the Lord by Moses.
text_cn: 这是刻哈特人的家族，所有在会幕内服务登记的人数，是梅瑟和亚郎依照上主给梅瑟的命令所统计的。

text_en: The enrollment of the Gershonites, by their clans and their ancestral houses,
text_cn: 革尔雄的子孙，依照宗族和家系登了记，

text_en: from thirty years old up to fifty years old, everyone who qualified for work relating to the tent of meeting—
text_cn: 由三十岁以上到五十岁，凡应入伍到会幕服务，

text_en: their enrollment by their clans and their ancestral houses was two thousand six hundred thirty.
text_cn: 依照宗族和家系登记的，共二千六百三十人：

text_en: This was the enrollment of the clans of the Gershonites, all who served at the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron enrolled according to the commandment of the Lord .
text_cn: 这是革尔雄子孙的家族所有在会幕内服务的登记人数，是梅瑟和亚郎依上主的命令所统计的。

text_en: The enrollment of the clans of the Merarites, by their clans and their ancestral houses,
text_cn: 默辣黎子孙的家族，依照宗族和家系都登了记，

text_en: from thirty years old up to fifty years old, everyone who qualified for work relating to the tent of meeting—
text_cn: 由三十岁以上到五十岁，凡应入伍到会幕服务，

text_en: their enrollment by their clans was three thousand two hundred.
text_cn: 依照宗族登记的，共三千二百人：

text_en: This is the enrollment of the clans of the Merarites, whom Moses and Aaron enrolled according to the commandment of the Lord by Moses.
text_cn: 这是默辣黎子孙家族登记的人数，是梅瑟和亚郎依照上主给梅瑟的命令所统计的。

text_en: All those who were enrolled of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the leaders of Israel enrolled, by their clans and their ancestral houses,
text_cn: 梅瑟和亚郎并以色列的首领，依照宗族和家系，统计的肋未人的总数，

text_en: from thirty years old up to fifty years old, everyone who qualified to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens relating to the tent of meeting,
text_cn: 由三十岁以上到五十岁，凡应入伍到会幕服务管理搬运的，

text_en: their enrollment was eight thousand five hundred eighty.
text_cn: 共计八千五百八十人。

text_en: According to the commandment of the Lord through Moses they were appointed to their several tasks of serving or carrying; thus they were enrolled by him, as the Lord commanded Moses.
text_cn: 依照上主藉梅瑟所发的命令，给他们每人指定了各人应尽的职务和应搬运的工作；依照上主对梅瑟所吩咐的，他们都这样登记了。
